_comment: Schools whose NFHS Network slug cannot be derived from the name. The harvester matches strictly - every distinctive word of the school name must appear as a whole hyphen-separated word in the slug, and no slug may serve two schools - so it refuses rather than guessing, and what it refuses is listed here. Resolve each against the sitemap and pick by event-card count when two records compete. null means the school is genuinely not on NFHS Network.

_notes.Roselle: Roselle's public high school is named Abraham Clark. The other candidates are Roselle Catholic and Roselle PARK, which are different schools.
_notes.Plainfield: North Plainfield and South Plainfield are separate districts; this is plain Plainfield.
_notes.Union: Union Catholic is in Scotch Plains and Union CITY is in Hudson County - three different schools sharing a word.
_notes.Summit: Oak Knoll, Kent Place and Oratory Prep are all in Summit too.
